dedupe_keys.name: parking relais en ile de france

description: Parking relais en Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Couche géographique décrivant les Parkings Relais d'Île-de-France. Définition Un parking relais est un parking de stationnement aménagé à proximité immédiate d’une gare ou d’une station de métro, dont la vocation est de faciliter l’accès des voyageurs au réseau ferré. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Voiture, Stationnement, Géolocalisation, Transports en commun. The portal shows 78 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
